title: Parking Assistant and Remote Parking
summary: Feedback on parking-related features centers on liking the parking assistant and remote parking concept, while some reviews mention remote parking problems or uncertainty about how the features and parking brake behavior work.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the parking assistant feature and remote parking availability or appeal.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention remote parking issues and dissatisfaction tied to parking assistant guidance or performance.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly describe feature operation, package availability, learning difficulty, or unclear parking brake and assistant behavior without a consistently explicit sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in drawing a clear sentiment pattern from the examples.
Several fragments are descriptive or procedural rather than evaluative, and some undetermined examples contain sentiment-like wording that cannot be reclassified.
The topic mixes parking assistant, remote parking, package availability, and parking brake behavior, so not all examples reflect the same specific issue.
